title: City Council - Amended
motion: Councilmember Vawdrey moved to approve Ordinance #1586 with the following amendments to the Amended Development Agreement: cul- de-sac with 80’ driving surface, no curb, and gutter; setbacks for lots with detached accessory dwelling units (D-ADU) are seven feet on the side yards, ten feet to the rear except the rear setbacks on the lots in the middle island which are twelve feet; D-ADUs are only allowed on lots greater than or equal to 11,000 square feet with the total number capped at 27; D-ADU height is capped at 28 feet in two stories; only one ADU is allowed on each lot regardless of type
